---
title: "Table Data"
---

The `table` block contains the actual table data, split into `thead` and `tbody`.

## Structure

```json
{
  "table": {
    "thead": { "rows": [...] },
    "tbody": [RowGroup, ...]
  }
}
```

## thead

```json
{
  "thead": {
    "rows": [{
      "role": "column_label",
      "style_id": null,
      "cells": [{
        "content": [{ "type": "text", "value": "Name" }],
        "colspan": 1, "rowspan": 1,
        "style_id": null,
        "is_stub": false, "is_placeholder": false,
        "scope": "col"
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

## tbody (Row Groups)

The body is an array of row groups. Each group has a label, data rows, and optional summary rows.

```json
{
  "tbody": [{
    "group_id": "grp_1",
    "label": {
      "content": [{ "type": "text", "value": "North America" }],
      "style_id": null,
      "colspan": null
    },
    "rows": [{ "role": null, "cells": [...] }],
    "summary_rows": []
  }]
}
```

## Row Fields

| Field      | Type    | Required | Description |
|------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `cells`    | array   | Yes      | Exactly `config.table_cols` cells |
| `role`     | string? | No       | `"column_label"` or `"spanner_label"` in `thead`; `"summary_row"` or `"grand_summary_row"` in a group's `summary_rows` |
| `style_id` | string? | No       | Style applied to the whole row |

## Cell Fields

| Field           | Type    | Required | Description                       |
|-----------------|---------|----------|-----------------------------------|
| `content`       | array   | Yes      | Array of ContentNode              |
| `typed_value`   | object? | No       | Typed data value                  |
| `colspan`       | integer | Yes      | Column span (≥ 1)                 |
| `rowspan`       | integer | Yes      | Row span (≥ 1)                    |
| `style_id`      | string? | No       | Style reference                   |
| `is_stub`       | boolean | Yes      | Whether cell is a row label       |
| `is_placeholder`| boolean | Yes      | Whether cell is a span placeholder|
| `scope`         | string? | No       | `"col"`, `"row"`, `"colgroup"`, `"rowgroup"` |
| `sort_key`      | any?    | No       | Sort value                        |
| `data_type`     | string? | No       | Value type: `"string"`, `"number"`, `"integer"`, `"boolean"`, `"date"`, `"datetime"`, `"time"`, `"duration"` |

## Typed Values

`typed_value` is the value behind a cell's display, `{"type": …, "value": …}`, with a
`type` from the `data_type` list. Writers that keep values (XLSX) read `value` as:

| `type`                 | `value`                                             |
|------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| `number`, `integer`    | a JSON number                                       |
| `boolean`              | `true` or `false`                                   |
| `date`                 | an ISO 8601 date string: `"2024-03-15"`             |
| `datetime`             | `"2024-03-15T14:30:00"` (or a space for the `T`; seconds and their fraction optional; no offset) |
| `time`                 | `"14:30:00"` (seconds and their fraction optional)  |

The value is what the cell holds; `content` is still what it shows. A value in
another form is kept as text.

```json
{ "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Mar 15, 2024"}],
  "typed_value": {"type": "date", "value": "2024-03-15"}, ... }
```

## Spans and Placeholders

Cells with `colspan` or `rowspan` > 1 span multiple positions. Spanned-over positions
**must** contain placeholder cells:

```json
[
  { "content": [{"type": "text", "value": "Wide"}], "colspan": 2, "is_placeholder": false, ... },
  { "content": [], "colspan": 1, "is_placeholder": true, "is_stub": false, ... }
]
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Placeholder cells must have **empty** `content`. The validator rejects non-empty placeholders.
:::
